escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read/Execution (RCE)
escalations.description: Vitest UI server allows unauthenticated reading and execution of arbitrary files on the system. Complete system compromise vector.
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker with network access to localhost:51204 (or exposed port) reads .env, executes arbitrary backend scripts — no authentication required.

escalations.title: Handlebars.js Multiple JavaScript Injection / Prototype Pollution
escalations.description: Handlebars template engine allows attackers to inject arbitrary JavaScript via AST type confusion. If untrusted templates are processed at runtime, this is a full SSTI/RCE vector.
escalations.exploit_scenario: If backend processes user-supplied Handlebars templates, attacker injects malicious AST payload to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the server process.
escalations.fix: npm update handlebars@4.7.9+; verify grep -r 'handlebars' Source/Backend/src

escalations.title: Vite server.fs.deny Bypass via Windows Alternate Paths
escalations.description: Vite file-system boundary enforcement bypassed on Windows via alternate path encodings. Leaks .env and config files.
escalations.exploit_scenario: On a Windows dev machine, attacker with local access sends UNC-encoded requests to Vite dev server, bypassing server.fs.deny to read .env or secrets outside root.

escalations.title: form-data CRLF Injection in Multipart Field Names
escalations.description: Multipart form field names and filenames are not CRLF-escaped. Enables request smuggling and header injection.
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker uploads file with CRLF-injected filename, manipulating multipart headers to poison cache or forge response headers.

p1_findings.title: Specifications/ not source of truth — 79 requirements untraced
p1_findings.description: CLAUDE.md mandates Specifications/ as canonical truth, but 79 of 79 official requirements are untraced in Source/. The codebase traces only to Plans/ requirements.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Audit gates pass (false green) while 79 domain requirements have zero implementation. Any regression in those requirement areas is invisible.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add FR-WS-XXX IDs to Specifications/workflow-engine.md; update enforcer to scan Specifications/; mark dev-workflow-platform.md as SUPERSEDED.

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer reports false PASSED — scans Plans/ not Specifications/
p1_findings.description: The enforcer auto-discovers Plans/ requirements and reports PASSED while ignoring all 79 Specifications/ requirements. CI gates are misleading.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: CI reports TRACEABILITY PASSED on a codebase that satisfies 0% of official spec coverage. All spec-drift regressions go undetected.
p1_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer with --specs-dir mode scanning Specifications/*.md for FR-XXX identifiers.

p2_findings.title: Route handlers directly access store — service layer bypassed
p2_findings.description: 9 store.* call sites in route handlers violate the no-direct-DB-from-routes architecture rule.
p2_findings.recommendation: Consolidate all store access into workItemService.ts; route handlers call service only.

p2_findings.title: OpenTelemetry tracing absent from backend
p2_findings.description: Zero OTel imports across all backend source files. CLAUDE.md arch rule is non-negotiable.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node + auto-instrumentations; initialize in app.ts before route registration.

p2_findings.title: GET /api/search not wired in app.ts — all search tests fail
p2_findings.description: search.test.ts explicitly documents that the route is unimplemented. Frontend client.ts also calls GET /api/search, so the feature fails at runtime.
p2_findings.recommendation: Implement GET /api/search?q= in workItems.ts and register in app.ts.

p2_findings.title: Express 4.21–4.22.1 DoS — current 4.18.2 is SAFE
p2_findings.description: Advisory: do not upgrade express to 4.21.x-4.22.1 range. Current version is not vulnerable.
p2_findings.recommendation: Hold at express@4.18.2 until 4.22.2+ is available.

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion multiple DoS vectors (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.description: Three DoS vectors via pattern expansion: process hang, memory exhaustion, OOM crash.

p2_findings.title: js-yaml quadratic-complexity DoS via merge keys
p2_findings.description: YAML parsing with many merge key aliases causes quadratic CPU exhaustion.
